caption:
Four supermoons in a row. One just rose.

A full Moon rose on Nov 24 as the Sun set opposite it.
It was near perigee, the closest point of the Moon’s oval orbit.
That makes a supermoon: bigger and brighter.

What the astronomers say: the next supermoon rises on December 23, the Cold Moon.

NASA picture: MSFC, MAF_20240819_SuperBlueMoon01. This real photo shows a different supermoon, over Alabama in 2024.
